**Finding submitted: TRANSITION — missing (insert), preferred level.**

- **Investigation:** Searched the whole agreement for transition/exit, data return/export and deletion language. Sections 13 (Term) and 14 (Termination) at p0078–p0079 contain only Client-side burdens (arranging a new name server within 30 days, a new hosting environment within 60 days) plus domain-ownership confirmation; Section 10 (Confidentiality, p0061–p0068) has no return-or-destroy mechanic; the survival clause (p0090) adds nothing. No responsive Vendor obligation exists anywhere.
- **Classification:** Missing — no data return at all is walk-away territory, so an insert is warranted rather than a rationale note.
- **Cure:** One `insert_after` p0079 as new Section 14a carrying only the six preferred elements — six months' assistance at TrueLink's then-current rates, return of Client Content and other Client data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days of expiry or termination, and certified deletion after that return. No survival tail, procedure or other boilerplate added; the existing termination sentence is untouched.
